corrections.why: Administration moved from the Bitterroot NF to the Nez Perce NF in 1957; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both name the Nez Perce NF.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The USFS list and Kresek (via Forest Lookouts) give 1925 for the first structure; firelookout.com dates the 20-foot platform to 1928 and the cupola cabin to 1929. The story gives the spread rather than choosing one.

notes_for_editor: Brief's agency (Bitterroot NF) is the pre-1957 agency; see corrections. First build date conflicts (1925 vs 1928 for the platform). Idaho Fire Lookouts' Known Staff block shows ??? above the Dunlop name, so treat the staff entry as unverified. The USFS list cites photos from 1927-1929 but gives no image URL, so no photos added. No source states access level; access left out of facts.
